integrity: The proof rewrites the published update row by row using invariance of propositional truth, proves idempotence directly, and proves a necessary-and-sufficient universal commutation criterion by a four-case sufficiency argument and an empty-row necessity witness. The primary full text was inspected at Definition 4.1, Theorem 4.2, the preservation discussion, Proposition 6.3, and the conclusion. Targeted published-finding and literature searches did not locate the result; a related KR 2026 contraction paper was accessible only at metadata level and is recorded as a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the hedged public announcement contraction of Belardinelli--Zhang with propositional contraction contents. It does not classify modal contraction contents, contractions mixed with expansion or revision, or arbitrary generalized event models. The universal commutation criterion can be stronger than commutation on a particular fixed relation.
title: Idempotence and exact commutation of propositional hedged contractions
